comment: Voiceover script for the marketing video. Order defines scene order. `clip` names the recorded footage (from record.mjs), `min`/`max` bound the scene length in seconds; the assembler stretches each scene to fit its narration. Optional `say` is the pronunciation-respelled text actually sent to the TTS ('Neuroster' phonemizes badly, so it is respelled 'Newroster'); `vo` stays the human-readable line.

scenes.vo: This is Neuroster. A world-building colony game, where the workers... are hamsters.
scenes.say: This is Newroster. A world-building colony game, where the workers are hamsters.

scenes.vo: Found your colony in a living world. Choose your biome, and your first hamsters get straight to work: digging, hauling, and settling in.
Mine materials, refine them, and raise an ever-larger settlement. Farms, mills, storage depots, workshops. Automate the toil, and watch the whole colony come alive.
Every rodent has a name, a family, and a job to do. Keep them fed, watered, curious, and healthy.
But the wild is always watching.
Predators, disasters, rival factions. Raise a garrison, research new skills, and evolve your rodents to meet whatever comes.
Neuroster. Your colony. Your world. Start digging.
scenes.say: Newroster. Your colony. Your world. Start digging.
